_about: Ranger reputation (List 21, #201): a DERIVED projection of public belief about a Ranger — the third shape beside #104's two. #104: predicates are derived/never stored; honours are STORED stamps on an individual Mochi's record. Reputation is derived like a predicate, but its subject is a Ranger and its content is what the world believes before meeting them. It is never stored and never spendable; a stored reputation score is belief turned into currency and is forbidden by shape.

honours_104.audience: the record itself (a private fact of a life)
honours_104.form: stored stamps — earned-event facts with provenance
honours_104.subject: an individual Mochi

reputation_201.audience: the world — NPC belief before any meeting
reputation_201.form: derived projection, evaluated at read time, stored NOWHERE
reputation_201.spendable: NEVER — no price, gate, or discount reads it
reputation_201.subject: a Ranger

inputs_exactly: licence tier (#98's tier field — itself derived standing; thresholds and names OPEN there)
mission service facts (#164 completion facts; plus the service-stamp occasion #164 proposed into #104's catalogue, read only if that catalogue accepts it)
public landmark facts (#12 flags of public shape — circuit completions, the champion fact class #100/#126)
inputs_excluded_by_law: anything purchasable — a reputation money can move is a price list
no_consumer_law: Reputation opens nothing. Gates read their own facts (#133 trials read licence inputs; #127 connections read arrival evidence). Any system wanting reputation as an input must propose it INTO #201's file. Until then, consumers are presentational only: #93 greeting/scheduling texture, #145 travellers' tales, #172 broadcast mentions — the world's mouth, never its locks.
open_register: the standing-class vocabulary + thresholds (owner/design; gated on #98's OPEN tier table)
which #12 flags classify as 'public shape' (a per-flag classification recorded on #12's side)
the service-stamp occasion's acceptance in #104's honours catalogue (the owner's slot)
any first consumer beyond presentation (a proposal into #201's file — or none; none is a fine answer)
output: qualitative standing CLASSES, never a number. The class vocabulary is a presentation slot (OPEN — design lane words them). Classes keyed to tier inherit #98's OPEN thresholds: the rule shape ships, the threshold table ships empty, stated plainly.
show_lane_mirror: Reputation precedes the Ranger and is PLAYED, not rendered: no meter, no score, no title card. In a scene, a character's reputation is exactly what the other characters believe — which the facts may or may not deserve.
